estimands.unit: capture (one qchart_*.npz: one S-Inhibition -> Name Mover head pair x prompt seed); 31 captures
estimands.readout: logit(IO) - logit(S) at the final position (ioi_query_chart.collect)
estimands.rmse: sqrt(mean over held-out rows of (Y - Yhat)^2), readout units; held-out rows = single-site rows of held-out donors (S) or joint rows with both donors held out (J); seed-0 donor partition
estimands.r2: 1 - SSE / sum over the same held-out rows of (Y - mean of those held-out Y)^2
estimands.rmse_pct_swing: 100 * rmse / ptp(B-arm single-site readout, full data) -- a reporting unit only, not used in any fit
estimands.heldout_aggregation: median (and q25/q75) over captures of the per-capture value; pair 'X->Y' = fitted on training rows of family X, scored on held-out rows of family Y
estimands.partition_sensitivity: the capture-median of rmse / r2 for each of seeds 0..9 (donor_protocol-style partitions), and its min-max across seeds
estimands.med_S_pct: median over captures of [median over joint states of the 95% Wald worst case of |D c|, c and its covariance fitted on ALL single-site rows] / ptp(B-arm readout), x100
estimands.med_J_pct: as med_S_pct with c fitted on all joint (support-matched) rows
estimands.max_S_pct: median over captures of [max over joint states of the same worst case] / swing, x100
estimands.log10cond: log10 condition number of the FWL partial information for the cross block (identifiability.partial_info), full-data whitening; median over captures
